photos.desc: Ruby-throated hummingbird, Bafflin Audubon Sanctuary, Pomfret, CT USA
We spotted this male ruby-throated hummingbird perched on a badminton net near a hummingbird feeder, defending his territory! Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
Rainy days don’t seem to slow down this hummingbird! We spotted this guy keeping a close eye on the feeder while perching in a nearby tree. Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
A female ruby-throated hummingbird visits a hummingbird feeder. Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
